axis/G01.name: G01
axis/G01.notes: low-frequency correlated field x distance/incidence variance x a fixed outlier probability; the deployment estimate is reported separately from the audit reference RMS.

axis/G02.name: G02
axis/G02.notes: fixed nested prefix of the frozen order with a point budget; an effective N0 source keeps its real size at level 0 (no upsampling to a nominal budget).

axis/G03.name: G03
axis/G03.notes: connected holes on the observed lattice: the seed positions are frozen in the basis and only the hole radius grows with the level, so the removed sets are nested by construction and the hole area/posi

axis/G04.name: G04
axis/G04.notes: per-frame SE(3) perturbation followed by a real re-fusion of the per-view depth; translation and rotation are separate single-factor variants and pose_drift_profile is the explicitly bundled stress va

axis/G05.name: G05
axis/G05.notes: Open3D quadric edge collapse with a measured Hausdorff budget and an ROI retention constraint; level 0 bypasses the decimator entirely.

axis/G06.name: G06
axis/G06.notes: only the observation frame and the legal scale fields change; the truth reference hash must stay identical (plan 15.4).

axis/G07.name: G07
axis/G07.notes: focal / principal point / distortion are separate single-factor variants; the perturbation is applied before back-projection and the frames are re-fused. calibration_profile changes all three and is l

axis/G08.name: G08
axis/G08.notes: three spurious-surface variants (support bump, warped hole lid, connecting bridge) reuse synlab.observe.spurious.apply_spurious; only the observed entity changes and spurious_mask stays an audit/super

axis/I01.name: I01
axis/I01.notes: Gaussian PSF in the plane, applied to the linear signal before the response; the depth-dependent variant blends two PSFs by depth and needs per-frame depth.

axis/I02.name: I02
axis/I02.notes: single-exposure directional kernel by default; the exposure_integration variant integrates a frozen number of sub-exposures along the same trajectory.

axis/I03.name: I03
axis/I03.notes: linear sensor noise y = Poisson(g*x)/g + N(0,sigma^2) with x = max(L*2^EV, 0); photon_scale varies the photon gain with the read noise fixed, read_sigma does the opposite, and camera_noise_profile cha

axis/I04.name: I04
axis/I04.notes: exposure_gain acts before the photon count; digital_gain is registered separately (it is not interchangeable). The negative sub-configuration is its own variant and the dark and bright directions are

axis/I05.name: I05
axis/I05.notes: one frozen gain-direction vector; the developed profile is frozen after calibration

axis/I06.name: I06
axis/I06.notes: scene light/BRDF re-render; the zero level is the same-source baseline scene and does not claim the physical glaze has no highlight. Changing BRDF, exposure and light angle together is labelled BUNDLE

axis/I07.name: I07
axis/I07.notes: 3-D occluder bodies are added to the scene and the views are re-rendered; a delivered-pixel patch would not be an occluder.

axis/I08.name: I08
axis/I08.notes: fixed-priority nested deletion; the baseline V0 source is returned unchanged at level 0 and every level is a subset of the previous one.

axis/I09.name: I09
axis/I09.notes: baseline long edge is kept at level 0; non-zero levels apply an anti-aliased downsample and update K through the frozen pixel transform. 1/8 is the extra stress level of the plan's candidate list.

axis/I10.name: I10
axis/I10.notes: level 0 does not re-encode at all; non-zero levels run a real JPEG encode/decode and report bytes, error RMS and blockiness.

axis/P01.name: P01
axis/P01.notes: fixed filter radius and full recession basis; only recession_strength moves. The radius scan is a separate variant and never claims the same-basis nesting. radius_mm=2.0 is the resolution-qualified ch

axis/P02.name: P02
axis/P02.notes: edge-distance driven inward fillet built from the analytic rolling-ball section of every convex edge on the ROI boundary and subtracted from the source; never a whole-patch Laplacian and never a globa

axis/P03.name: P03
axis/P03.notes: non-negative smooth recession over the interface ROI with a wall-thickness guard; the depth field is frozen in the basis and pinned to zero on the ROI rim, so the five levels are nested and the untouc

axis/P04.name: P04
axis/P04.notes: fixed cutter position/direction frozen in the basis; the cutter size is found by a 1-D geometric search that brackets the declared contact loss and then bisects, subject to the frozen minimum represen

axis/P05.name: P05
axis/P05.notes: nested paint masks from one frozen rank field; the geometry hash must stay identical (appearance-only axis).

axis/P06.name: P06
axis/P06.notes: smooth patch coverage of one frozen field; the core variant changes appearance only (geometry hash unchanged) and dirt_geometry adds an explicit contamination body registered as its own material class

axis/P07.name: P07
axis/P07.notes: original outer-surface ROI only; hidden surfaces are never backfilled

axis/P08.name: P08
axis/P08.notes: three single-factor variants (crack width, coat area, painted-coat loss) plus one explicitly bundled stress variant; crack width, crack length and layer area are never mixed into one comparable intens

axis/X01.name: X01
axis/X01.notes: modalities are removed from the payload (presence=false) 闂?never replaced by a zero image that claims to be valid data.

axis/X02.name: X02
axis/X02.notes: boundary px error / missing blob / false positive are separate variants; every crop or ROI change updates K and the pixel transform, and the research mask (mask_reference) is never presented as the in

axis/X03.name: X03
axis/X03.notes: missing context and conflicting context are separate variants; a missing context is never constructed as a necessary conflict (plan 15.5).

axis/X04.name: X04
axis/X04.notes: only the real OBS_EST fields are perturbed (never an oracle intensity). The regression variant shifts the estimate by a frozen multiple of its own measured spread, so the bias is comparable across cha

axis/X05.name: X05
axis/X05.notes: baseline plus four held-out camera/light/ISP presets; this is a categorical shift, so no scalar monotonicity is claimed between levels.
